activities.title: The repaired bicycle
activities.content: Read about a neighbour who returns a favour.
activities.question: Why does Kamal repair Mrs Ortiz's bicycle?
activities.option_a: he wants to sell it to her
activities.option_b: she helped him when his bicycle broke down
activities.option_c: his teacher assigned him the repair
accepted_answers_json: she helped him when his bicycle broke down
activities.explanation: Kamal remembers Mrs Ortiz helping him after his own bicycle failed, so he offers to help her.
activities.story_text:
On his way home from school, Kamal noticed that Mrs Ortiz was pushing her bicycle along the pavement. The chain had slipped off, and she did not know how to fix it. Kamal remembered the afternoon his own bicycle had broken down in the rain. Mrs Ortiz had driven him home and helped him call his father.

Kamal asked if she had a few minutes. Using a small tool from his bag, he carefully put the chain back and checked that the wheel turned freely. Mrs Ortiz offered to pay him, but Kamal shook his head. He thanked her for helping him last month and said he was happy to return the favour. She smiled, tested the bicycle, and rode away.
